changelog: Hardens the Observatory's status endpoint so it cannot fail as a whole. Each reading - process memory, CPU time, database size, queue depths, integration status, counters - is now taken independently, and a source the server cannot read falls back to a placeholder and names itself, with the reason, in a Degraded readings panel at the top of the Overview page. Previously a single unavailable reading made the entire request fail, which left the dashboard showing nothing but an error and gave no indication which reading was at fault. A diagnostics endpoint that answers with an error tells an operator only that the diagnostics are broken too. No engine behaviour, configuration or database changes.
